title: CALION central-TES study (DHN-A): model code, synthetic example and aggregated results
description: Supplementary code and data for L. Ruess, A. Sauer, Central thermal energy storage at an industrial prosumer site: value, hydraulic limits and foresight in a meshed district heating network, Energy (2026). Hourly MILP dispatch (Pyomo/HiGHS) of an existing district heating network with a central pressurised TES, an industrial waste-heat heat pump and an electrode boiler, coupled to a calibrated hydraulic equivalent network (Mode E / Mode H), Shapley attribution, rolling horizon, south hosting capacity and a pandapipes cross-check. The package contains the model code, configuration, tests, a synthetic example input that runs the pipeline end to end, the aggregated results behind all tables and figures, and the figure PDFs. Measured network data, operator plan data and partner data are under non-disclosure agreements and are not included.
